TITLE: High Tech Campus Eindhoven

High Tech Campus Eindhoven
Homebase for breakthrough technology and innovation
Explore your opportunities
Visit the Campus
Where the world's brightest minds shape tomorrow's solutions
Home to a thriving, collaborative ecosystem of over 300 high tech companies, researchers and institutions, High Tech Campus Eindhoven is your gateway to state-of-the-art facilities, world-class expertise and a dynamic network.
About us
Welcome to Europe's smartest square kilometer
Situated within a lush, green environment, we empower groundbreaking businesses to connect, experiment and grow.

Innovation across
4 key technology
clusters
View tech clusters
Health & MedTech
Innovators in medical devices and digital health are improving diagnostics and care, supported by a strong network of specialized service providers on Campus.
CleanTech & Energy
From sustainable energy generation and battery technology to carbon capture and smart software, at HTCE a wide variety of companies work on a more sustainable future.
Semicon & Photonics
From advanced chip design and integrated photonics to equipment manufacturing, this cluster contains key players who are pushing the boundaries of technology.
Software & AI
As a hotspot for Europe’s strategic AI ambitions, HTCE connects next-gen AI hardware and software companies to drive adoption and innovation in the era of Artificial Intelligence.
